items.title: A dinner with strangers
sentences: Last week my neighbour Clara invited me to a small dinner at her flat.
I did not know any of the other guests, so I felt rather shy when I arrived.
Luckily, the man sitting next to me turned out to be a friendly engineer who loved talking about his travels.
He told me about a trip he had taken to Peru, and soon we were laughing like old friends.
By the end of the evening, I had forgotten that I had ever been nervous.
Yesterday I sent Clara a message to thank her, and she promised to invite me again soon.

explanation.en: 'the other guests' belongs to the dinner. 'Luckily' answers the shyness, 'He' is the engineer, 'nervous' repeats the idea of 'shy', and 'Yesterday' comes after the evening.
explanation.es: 'the other guests' pertenece a la cena. 'Luckily' contesta a la timidez, 'He' es el ingeniero, 'nervous' repite la idea de 'shy' y 'Yesterday' va después de la velada.

note.en: A later time than the evening.
note.es: Un momento posterior a la velada.
